en: The front image shows a black-and-white photograph of a grand public square framed by ornate 19th-century European buildings. The square has a large, decorative fountain in its center, surrounded by manicured gardens, benches, and walking paths. The back of the postcard has addresses and Swedish postage marks, as well as a Swedish 5 öre stamp dated 1903. The word 'Vängåfvan' is visible on the front, referring to a well-known landmark.
